id: \bGrandma says it is always peaceful, but she always forgets about the Pokémon attacks.
en: \bGrandma says it is always peaceful, but she always forgets about the Pokémon attacks.
it: \bLa nonna dice che qui c'è sempre pace, ma si dimentica sempre degli attacchi dei Pokémon.

id: \bThey swarm here because of all the pollen.
en: \bThey swarm here because of all the pollen.
it: \bArrivano a sciami per via di tutto quel polline.

id: \rThis town is so peaceful. May it always stay that way.
en: \rThis town is so peaceful. May it always stay that way.
it: \rQuesta città è così tranquilla. Che possa restare sempre così.

id: \bPokémon know how to use berries. That means if you let them hold onto them they will use it in battle without your command.
en: \bPokémon know how to use berries. That means if you let them hold onto them they will use it in battle without your command.
it: \bI Pokémon sanno come usare le bacche. Quindi, se gliele fai tenere, le useranno in lotta senza che tu glielo ordini.

id: \bBe sure to always plant berries. Help spread them everywhere.
en: \bBe sure to always plant berries. Help spread them everywhere.
it: \bRicordati di piantare sempre le bacche. Aiuta a diffonderle ovunque.

id: \rI teach a poffin class in town.
en: \rI teach a poffin class in town.
it: \rTengo un corso di Poffin in città.
\rI Poffin fanno bene alla tua squadra.

id: \bI hate all the flowers here. Help me get rid of them.
en: \bI hate all the flowers here. Help me get rid of them.
it: \bOdio tutti questi fiori. Aiutami a sbarazzarmene.

id: \bWhy are you in here? Get out!
en: \bWhy are you in here? Get out!
